content.text: Every creator in a platform-restricted country eventually arrives at the same moment: the application rejected, the payout held, the account flagged for no stated reason. Stripe does not support your country. PayPal's compliance engine decided your location is high-risk. Gumroad cannot pay you because Stripe cannot move the money. These are not bugs. They are the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-presets-without-stripe-what-nobody-tells-you-3|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-first-principles-definitive|Selling Design]]-courses-without-teachable-stripe|architecture]] working exactly as designed — for a specific set of markets, and against yours. The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Stripe operates in 46 countries, leaving a significant portion of the world without access. PayPal, on the other hand, can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have limited country support, making them unreliable for creators in restricted regions. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a permanent structural alternative, providing a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, all without relying on these conventional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's limited country support means that creators in restricted regions are forced to find alternative solutions. PayPal's country restrictions and fund-holding policies further exacerbate the problem. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy's limited country support make them unreliable for creators in these regions. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to work in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional platforms are unavailable or severely restricted, providing a reliable solution for digital creators in these regions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe's fees can range from 2.9% + 30 cents per transaction to 0.8% + 3 cents per transaction, depending on the country and type of payment. PayPal's fees can range from 2.9% + 30 cents per transaction to 4.4% + 0.30 USD per transaction. Gumroad's fees can range from 3.5% + 30 cents per transaction to 8% + 30 cents per transaction. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure charges a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, making it a more cost-effective solution for digital creators.

COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only solution that provides full ownership of customer data, automation of delivery, and instant product delivery without relying on conventional platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe and PayPal require creators to hand over ownership of their customer data, making it difficult to maintain control over their customer relationships. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also require creators to cede control over their customer data. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure provides creators with full ownership of their customer data, allowing them to maintain control over their customer relationships and automate delivery of their digital products, all without relying on conventional platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Creators in restricted regions can choose COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. Creators who value cost-effectiveness can choose COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, which charges a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions. Creators who prioritize automation and delivery can choose COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, which provides a reliable solution for delivering digital products without relying on conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
